pages.text: Cost: 80 biomass. Offer 6 Tissue Fiber, 2 Hive Vein, 2 Living Hive Tissue, 1 Blighted Wither Core. Each infected Wither drops one core.$(br2)Equip in the feet slot for +25 attack damage. All four add 100 to the opening hit before the infinite Strength multiplier.$(br2)Narrow black glints skim the ankles and shoes.
